data.name: Kilian
data.gender_notes: Kilian is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Cilianus', meaning 'of Kilia'. Kilian is a Roman saint who was a priest and a hermit. He was martyred by the Visigoths in the 3rd century. The name Kilian carries the meaning “Warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Kilian usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of courage, dedication, and perseverance.
data.etymology: Kilian belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kilian total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: קִילְיָן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מקור השם בעברית נובע מהשם קֵיל, ילד. נושא חשיבות רבה במסורת היהודית, ופירושו: 'עצמאי', 'פרטי', 'בודד'. ישנן שתי השקפות על מקור השם: האחת, כי קֵיל הוא צאצא של קיל, והשנייה, כי קֵיל היה שמו של עבד של אברהם. בברית החדשה, ישנן שתי פעמים, כאשר השם קֵיל נזכר כבן דוד של שמעון, מלך יהודה. שמעון, בנה של אלישבע, נשא את דינה, בת שכן, וכך נולדו לו, ביניהם, קֵיל.

in_greek.name: Κίλιαν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Κίλιαν προέρχεται από τα αρχαία ελληνικά και σημαίνει 'ελεύθερος', 'απάνθρωπος'. Ο Κίλιαν αναφέρεται επίσης ως το όνομα ενός αγίου, ο οποίος ζούσε στον 7ο αιώνα. Ο Κίλιαν ήταν ένας Γερμανός αββάς, ο οποίος έζησε στη Βουργουνδία, και θεωρείται σήμερα όσιος. Ο Κίλιαν ήταν γνωστός για τη φιλανθρωπία του και την ενθάρρυνση των ανθρώπων να γίνονται καλύτεροι.

in_latin.name: Kilianus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Kilianus a Graeco oriundum est. Liber, liberus. A Graeco Kilianus, liber, liberus. Nomen Kilianus in Ecclesia Christi significat libertatem, libertatem mentis. A Graeco Kilianus, liber, liberus. Sancti Kiliani, abbatem, qui in Burgundia vivebat, et qui sanctus habetur, qui in Ecclesia Christi, libertatem, libertatem mentis, significabat.

in_english.name: Kilian
in_english.meaning: free man, child of the free
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kilian is derived from the Latin name Kilianus, which is derived from the Greek name Κίλιαν. Kilian means 'free man', 'child of the free'. In Christian tradition, the name Kilian represents freedom, freedom of the mind. Kilian is also the name of a saint, Saint Kilian, an abbot who lived in Burgundy in the 7th century and is venerated in the Christian Church for his promotion of freedom and the development of the mind.

historical_references.reference: Saint Kilian was a Frankish bishop and Irish missionary, who became the patron saint of Würzburg, Germany. He is said to have been martyred in the late 7th century, probably around 689 AD, after converting the Franconian people to Christianity.
historical_references.context: Christian missionary among the Franconian people in Germany

historical_references.reference: According to tradition, Saint Kilian, along with two companions, Colman and Totnan, were sent by St. Columbanus, an Irish missionary, to convert the Germanic tribes in the region of modern-day Würzburg. They preached the Gospel, built a church and were eventually martyred for their faith.
historical_references.context: Irish missionaries sent to convert Germanic tribes in Germany

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Kilian is of Celtic origin and is associated with Saint Kilian, the patron saint of Ireland who is believed to have been a missionary and a bishop in the 7th century. In modern times, the name Kilian is commonly seen in Catholic contexts, particularly in relation to the celebration of this saint's life and works. It is also associated with Ireland and Irish culture. Additionally, the name Kilian has gained popularity in the brewing industry, with several craft breweries using the name for their beers. Social media platforms, such as Facebook and Twitter, are used to share information and updates about the life and legacy of Saint Kilian. Wikipedia is another platform where one can find extensive information about the saint. Beer packaging, such as beer labels and bottle designs, often feature the name Kilian, reflecting its Irish and Catholic connections.
